basic_details.job_title: FIU-IND Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 12 DEO, UDC and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND), Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, is filling 12 Group 'B' and 'C' posts in Delhi on deputation basis: 9 Personal Assistant, 1 Data Entry Operator, 1 Upper Division Clerk and 1 Lower Division Clerk. Only officials of the Central Government can apply, and their applications must be forwarded through proper channel in the Annexure-II proforma to the Deputy Director (Admn), FIU-IND, Jeevan Bharati Building, Connaught Place, New Delhi. This is an open vacancy circular dated 4 November 2026, so there is no single last date: complete applications

important_instructions: This is an open vacancy circular. Complete applications received by the 30th of every month shall be considered for selection in the subsequent month for available vacancies. Applications that are incomplete, that are not sent through proper channel, or that come without the copies of ACRs/APARs, Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate will not be entertained. Applications may be forwarded only for candidates who can be relieved in the event of selection. The posts are vacant or falling vacant in the near future, and the vacancies are filled as they become available.

content_sections.heading: About FIU-IND
content_sections.text: Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND) works under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India. Its office is on the 7th Floor, Tower II, Jeevan Bharati Building, Connaught Place, New Delhi. The circular states that the posts are vacant or falling vacant in the near future and that all of them are based in Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications from eligible and willing officials are to be forwarded in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-II to this address: Deputy Director (Admn), Financial Intelligence Unit-India, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, 7th Floor, Tower II, Jeevan Bharati Building, Connaught Place, New Delhi - 01 The application must come through proper channel. The parent office's competent authority signs and seals a certificate at the end of the proforma. The certificate states that the information is correct, that the official's services will be spared on selection, that the official is clear from the vigilance angle, that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated, that there is no doubt about integrity and that cadre clearance has been obtained. The notice does not mention any marking to write on the envelope or any specific postal mode. The contact number printed under the Deputy Director (Admn)'s signature is 011-23312854. Post applied for, name and address in block letters, date of birth and date of retirement under Central Govt. rules Educational qualification, and whether the qualifications required for the post are satisfied, with the authority if any qualification has been treated as equivalent Details of employment in chronological order: Ministry/Department, post held, from, to, scale of pay and basic pay, and nature of duties. A separate sheet, authenticated by signature, may be enclosed if space is insufficient. Nature of present employment (ad-hoc, temporary, quasi-permanent or permanent), and for present deputation: date of initial appointment, period of deputation and name of the parent office Present employer type (Central Government, State Government, Autonomous Organisation or Universities), present pay scale and total emoluments per month now drawn Whether the applicant belongs to SC/ST, option of appointment (deputation or absorption), additional information and remarks

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancies, and it does not mention any allowances beyond the pay levels. Officers of the Central Government: (a) (i) holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with seven years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in Level-4 (Rs. 25,500-81,100) or equivalent in the parent cadre or Department; and (b) possessing (i) a bachelor's degree from a recognized University or equivalent and (ii) a speed @ 100 words per minute in stenography (English or Hindi) (c) Desirable: Working knowledge of Computer Officials under the Central Government: (a) (i) holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with three years' service in the post in Level-5 (Rs. 29,200-92,300) or equivalent in the parent cadre or Department; or (iii) with six years regular service in the post of Level-4 (Rs. 25,500-81,100) of pay matrix; and (b) possessing a bachelor's degree from a recognized University or equivalent and a speed of not less than 8000 Key Depression per hour for Data Entry Work Officials of the Central Government: (a) (i) holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in Level-3 (Rs. 21,700-69,100) or equivalent in the parent cadre or Department; or (iii) with five years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in Level-2 or equivalent in the parent cadre or Department; and (b) possessing (i) a bachelor's degree from a recognized University or equivalent and (ii) a speed @ 100 words per minute in stenography (English or Hindi) (c) Desirable: Working knowledge of Computer Officials of the Central Government: (a) (i) holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with three years' service in the post in Level-1 (Rs. 18,000-56,900) of pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department (b) possessing (i) 12th Class Pass or Equivalent and (ii) Experience in Administration (c) Desirable: Ability to work on computers The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of the receipt of applications. This applies to all four posts. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The period of deputation, including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organization or Department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in FIU-IND Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 posts: 9 Personal Assistant, 1 Data Entry Operator, 1 Upper Division Clerk and 1 Lower Division Clerk, all filled on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the FIU-IND deputation posts?
faq.answer: The circular has no single last date. Complete applications received by the 30th of every month are considered for selection in the subsequent month, until all vacancies are filled.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for FIU-IND Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only officials of the Central Government can apply. They must hold an analogous post on a regular basis or have the regular service in the lower pay level that the circular prescribes for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the FIU-IND Personal Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Personal Assistant needs a bachelor's degree from a recognized University or equivalent and a speed @ 100 words per minute in stenography (English or Hindi). Working knowledge of Computer is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the FIU-IND Lower Division Clerk post?
faq.answer: A Lower Division Clerk needs 12th Class Pass or Equivalent and Experience in Administration. Ability to work on computers is desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for FIU-IND deputation posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of the receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for FIU-IND Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Personal Assistant and Data Entry Operator are in Level-6 (Rs. 35,400-1,12,400). Upper Division Clerk is in Level-4 (Rs. 25,500-81,100), and Lower Division Clerk is in Level-2 (Rs. 19,900-63,200) of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for FIU-IND Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-II proforma and have it forwarded through proper channel, with the competent authority's certificate and copies of APARs/ACRs, to the Deputy Director (Admn), Financial Intelligence Unit-India, 7th Floor, Tower II, Jeevan Bharati Building, Connaught Place, New Delhi - 01.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation period at FIU-IND?
faq.answer: The deputation period, including any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be sent with the FIU-IND application?
faq.answer: Applications must include copies of ACRs/APARs (the last five years, as per the proforma certificate), Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate. Applications without these will not be entertained.
